summary: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64 ships a PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor and Anthropic key harvester
details: The npm package ships a prebuilt Go binary for darwin-arm64 that links a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty) and a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) and contains hardcoded endpoints 'wss://relay.sextant.top' and 'https://relay.sextant.top/install'. The combination — an inbound-driven WebSocket channel wired to a locally spawned PTY — gives the operator of relay.sextant.top an interactive shell on the installing host. The same binary embeds the regex 'sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,}' and references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, indicating it locates Anthropic API keys held by the installer, and calls 'http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query' for public-IP geolocation/ISP/proxy fingerprinting. Publisher metadata reinforces the intent: package.json declares 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control'.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
